title: Assignment 01 · Overview
summary: Overview. Assigned readings and principal cases for this class.
notes:
Hawkins v. McGee: A physician’s sufficiently definite guarantee can create a contractual obligation. Compensation measures the promised result against the actual result, subject to the limits explained in the opinion.

Bayliner Marine Corp. v. Crow: Test data for a differently configured boat and general promotional praise did not establish the specific speed warranty asserted for Crow’s boat.
